lines: Come now, there's nothing to fear
No doubts at all
My dream is everyone's wish
When I sing, my heart clears
It's all right — I'm the strongest
My voice
Carries little birds into the sky
My billowing clothes are like dancers too
Your voice
Rouses me to my feet
If a thorn has stuck in you, come here, come here
Scenery no one's ever seen, something new
I can absolutely see it
Because
I'm alive today too
Come now, hands clasped in hands
Toward the light
Everyone's dream is my happiness
Ah, it exists nowhere else — only you have it
With that warmth, I'm the strongest
Even if it's the long way round
Wherever I walk is the right answer
I know that, and yet
I can't back down now
Even if it takes a little too much
I still want to water the flowers
Yes, in the end I have to do what I want to do
Or I'll rot inside, won't I? I'll live up to expectations
Someday it will come, that splendid age
For now I'm just waiting for someone
Repeating over and over, this bitter, bitter taste
Are you ready to light the fire?
Now then, let us go — to the very summit
Come now, is there nothing to fear?
No doubts at all?
Are my feelings too heavy for everyone?
When I sing, even the fog clears
Utterly, completely — I'm the most fearsome
Come now, hands clasped in hands
Toward the light
Everyone's dream is my wish
It exists nowhere else — only you have it
That weakness of yours is what shines
On the days I loved most
A vow I won't forget
The dream of someday is my heart
Again and again, as many times as it takes, I'll say it
"I am the strongest"
"Strongest, together with you"
"Strongest, together with you"
